**Wednesday August 20th Another “Battle for the intersection” at the intersection of 8th and Colorado Blvd.**

**Methodology:** These transcripts span several hours. Repeating telepathic “Citizen Tech” phenomena out loud while recording the conversation with the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions were generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** Upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the vehicles are tormented with the statement “Do not support this person!”.
